changeSet.sql:
delete from role_permission where role_id = (select id from role where name = 'ASSISTANT') and permission_id in (select id from permission where name in ('CREATE_EXERCISE','EDIT_EXERCISE','DELETE_EXERCISE'));
delete from role_permission where role_id = (select id from role where name = 'TEACHER') and permission_id in (select id from permission where name in ('CREATE_COURSE','DELETE_COURSE'));
